title: Dream game finally coming true
author: Otherwise_Tomato5552
selftext:
The Unreal MCP with Astra is amazing! FYI, the rex/houses were bought assets, but many things have been made with blender ( Triceratops and carnosaurus).  

I can finally start making the dinosaur games I always wanted to make.

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: Looks like a great start! What do you plan to do with it?

replies.author: Otherwise_Tomato5552
replies.body: Coop escape, like a blend of phasmaphobia and funnel runner

comments.author: soulglider26
comments.body: Very interesting start for sure. Is this a horror game?

replies.author: Otherwise_Tomato5552
replies.body: It’s a blend of phasmaphobia and funnel runners.  Coop escape

comments.body: What are you gonna do after your dreams come true?
